title: fix(ui): CI automation toggles lag and shift the popover
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes CI automation toggles jumping back and making the whole popover look like it reloads after each click.

## User Impact

Toggles respond immediately without adding lines or shifting the panel. Other options remain usable during a save. “Next check” details and automation links are removed; genuine errors and blockers remain visible. GitHub check and job links are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The popup now projects each pending choice independently while keeping Gateway job identities and revisions authoritative. Background reads cannot replace newer intent, and an uncertain save is reconciled without repeating the mutation.

Reported and requested by @steipete.

## Work sessions

- [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/dashboard/11859ee2-2126-41f3-bc71-0e02b6a423e5)

## Evidence

- The new optimistic-toggle regression failed on the original code (the checkbox reverted before acknowledgement) and passes with the fix.
- 69 focused controller/adapter/PR-footer tests pass, including overlapping writes, stale inventory, lost acknowledgements and context replacement. Final controller run: 2.29 seconds wall time (0.51 seconds test time); controller/footer run: 2.77 seconds wall time.
- All 7 bundled-browser scenarios pass (17.99 seconds total, 5.89 seconds test time): selected-PR writes, error recovery, read-only access, and desktop/mobile/landscape layouts.
- Fresh independent AutoReview: no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- UI and relevant test-graph typechecks, formatting, i18n, ratchets and dead-export checks pass. A test-fixture type error and four brace-style lint errors found during verification were corrected; focused lint, stylelint and regression checks pass.

![Before: CI automation scheduling rows and links](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/03c0e4d9-1a3e-449b-ae05-d0b400c454b0)

### After

Production code: +63/-133 (net -70). Tests: +176/-6. Mock Gateway browser proof, not live GitHub automation execution.
